# Paths whose change requires Ben's review.
#
# A pull request touching any of these is never merged by Claude. CI fails the
# `protected-paths` job unless the PR carries the `ben-review` label.
#
# One fnmatch-style glob per line, repo-relative. Blank lines and lines starting
# with `#` are ignored. Read by `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and asserted by
# `tests/test_repo_boundaries.py`, so the two can never drift.

# The boundaries themselves, and the file that states them.
CLAUDE.md
.claude/rules/*.md

# Release truths, certification, and every evidence gate.
src/nfl_dfs/release.py
src/nfl_dfs/certification.py
src/nfl_dfs/preflight.py
src/nfl_dfs/evidence.py
src/nfl_dfs/sources.py

# Registered policy: what counts as evidence, and what a metric may promote on.
config/evidence_policy.json
config/metric_registry_*.json

# The authority model itself.
.claude/settings.json
.github/protected-paths.txt
.github/workflows/*.yml
